categories.label: 合同名称
categories.query: agreement contract services service master maintenance consulting license licensing
categories.semantic_query: Find the formal title or name of the agreement, usually stated in the heading or opening sentence.

categories.label: 合同当事方
categories.query: agreement between among corporation company incorporated limited hereinafter party parties
categories.semantic_query: Find the legal names of every company or person that is a contracting party to the agreement.

categories.label: 协议签署日期
categories.query: agreement dated date made entered executed execution as of day witness
categories.semantic_query: Find the date on which the agreement was signed, executed, made, or entered into, not merely a later effective date.

categories.label: 生效日期
categories.query: effective date effect commence commencement beginning begins execution executed
categories.semantic_query: Find the date on which the agreement becomes legally effective or begins to operate.

categories.label: 初始期限到期日期
categories.query: initial term expire expires expiration expiry end ends ending commence commencement anniversary years months
categories.semantic_query: Find when the initial contract term expires or ends, before considering optional or automatic renewals.

categories.label: 续约期限
categories.query: renew renewal renewals renewed renewing automatically automatic successive extension extensions extended additional term
categories.semantic_query: Find whether the agreement renews and the length and mechanics of each renewal or extension period.

categories.label: 终止续约通知期限
categories.query: renew renewal renewed automatically successive nonrenewal notice written prior days months terminate termination expiration
categories.semantic_query: Find how much advance notice a party must give to stop an automatic renewal or decline a renewal term.

categories.label: 适用法律
categories.query: governing governed construed construction laws law state commonwealth jurisdiction conflicts
categories.semantic_query: Find the state, country, or jurisdiction whose laws govern and interpret the agreement.

categories.label: 保险义务
categories.query: insurance insured insurer coverage policies policy liability certificate maintain procure
categories.semantic_query: Find any obligation to obtain, maintain, prove, or provide insurance coverage or insurance certificates.

categories.label: 审计权
categories.query: audit auditing auditor inspect inspection examine examination books records accounts access
categories.semantic_query: Find any right to audit, inspect, examine, or access another party's books, records, accounts, systems, or facilities.

categories.label: 无因终止
categories.query: terminate termination convenience without cause any reason no reason at will notice
categories.semantic_query: Find whether a party may terminate the agreement without breach, default, or cause, including termination at will, for any reason, or at sole discretion.
